restatement_groups.reason: Vehicles with a lower bumper height below 425 mm shall be tested with the lower legform.
Vehicles with a lower bumper height above 500 mm shall be tested with the upper legform.
For a lower bumper height between 425 and 500 mm, the manufacturer chooses the lower or upper legform test.
The legform-to-bumper impact speed is 40 km/h.
